edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.mechanism: The counter-hypothesis is that broader microbial exposure may accelerate immune maturation and reduce some allergic outcomes, though the balance depends on timing and environment.
edges.summary: For allergic disease, the most useful starting point is the 2018 Wallace meta analysis in Cancer Epidemiol Biomarkers Prev. It found that daycare attendance produces mixed findings across studies, and the follow-on evidence is broadly consistent even when absolute benefit or harm is modest.
edges.caveats: Subgroup differences, dose thresholds, and competing mechanisms likely explain why the literature does not settle into one clean direction.
